column3: “Until David reigned” is rendered “until the reign of David.”
NASB separates “Ain, Rimmon”; the Hebrew reads “Ain-rimmon.”
“Dwelling places” is rendered “settlements,” and “recording genealogies” as “they have their genealogy.”
“Who came by names” is rendered “mentioned by name,” and “spread out” as “increased.”
Close to the Hebrew; some ancient versions read “Gerar.”
“Broad of both hands” is rendered “broad,” and “from Ham” as “Hamites.”
“Struck down” is rendered “attacked,” and “totally destroyed” as “destroyed … utterly.”
“At their head” is rendered “as their leaders.”
